patch_description: Replace the single circle-seed coordinate descent with a broad deterministic funnel: 72 seeds (random interior, jittered circle, 3-fold symmetric rings), a fast screening pass with coarse polish on the top 24, and an exact greedy hill-climb on the top 10 that moves the vertices of the current worst triangle (worst-case-driven refinement). The min-triangle evaluation is vectorized via a precomputed 286-triple index array, giving roughly a 50× speedup over the per-point loop and freeing the time budget for breadth — exactly what broke the plateau (Gen 27's 60–72 seeds reached 0.81, Gen 31's four-stage funnel 0.84). Objective throughout is min_triangle_area / hull_area, so hull spread is optimized jointly with triangle regularity.
